correctness.rationale: The equality/sort/incidence/collinearity/concurrency invariant is a partial isomorphism invariant for four pebbles. Every possible fourth extension from a three-anchor diagram falls, by point–line duality, into five exact configurations. The proof derives all extension counts from unique joins/meets and q+1 regularity. Every permitted category is nonempty for q>=3, uniformly in the plane, hence the invariant persists indefinitely and proves FO4 equivalence. For q=2 three concurrent lines cover all points; for q>=3 they do not, giving a four-variable separator. The FO3 and FO5 sharpness statements are separately justified. Two standalone code checks agree on finite coordinate instances; they are not substituted for the universal argument.

originality.rationale: The unrestricted-depth four-pebble equivalence of ALL finite projective planes of orders at least three is a new implication not supplied by earlier bounded-rank statements. The complete five-configuration extension-support argument differs from general logical machinery and from incidence-graph counting papers. Searches and primary sources below did not identify a stronger theorem, but priority remains qualified.
residual_risks: An unidentified general incidence-geometry theorem or a differently named fixed-variable-game theorem might imply the FO4 classification; literature coverage is not exhaustive.
A pre-1999 manuscript of the Venema study exists with no independently verified exact day of earliest release; it is background rather than the dated lead source.
The code tests only classical planes; correctness for non-Desarguesian planes depends on the axiomatic symbolic proof.

value.rationale: A complete unrestricted-depth FO4 spectrum for all finite projective planes (not merely bounded quantifier ranks), with sharp minimum-representative size 26 for the high-order class and sharp variable-width separations between orders two/three and three/four. In particular even non-Desarguesian planes of order at least three cannot be told apart by four-variable FO in the pure incidence language. This is a structural logical boundary with motivated model-theoretic content, not an arbitrary finite invariant.
